units.source_text: 黑83经过了一小时四十八分钟的长考，用时超过白70所用的一小时四十六分的纪录。

en.t: Black 83 came after a long deliberation of one hour and forty-eight minutes, exceeding the record of one hour and forty-six minutes used for White 70.

units.source_text: 七段支着双手，连同坐垫一起往后挪动了一下，然后凝视着棋盘右边，不一会儿又将手揣在怀里，挺着肚子。

en.t: The seventh-dan player braced himself with both hands and shifted backward a little, cushion and all; then he stared at the right side of the board, and before long tucked his hands back into his robe, thrusting out his belly.

units.source_text: 这是七段要长考的前兆。

en.t: This was a sign that the seventh-dan player was about to fall into a long deliberation.
